1) critical files for each hard gate (keys are gate IDs as in the gate registry), 
2) overall project category files under: Build, Config, Properties, Infrastructure, Deployment. 

AVAILABLE GATES (number | category | name | summary):
1.1 | Alerting | All alerting is actionable | Ensure operational reports are available for business review with quality information, training, and guidance. Complete Enterprise NFR and validate before production release.
1.1 | Auditability | Logs searchable/available | Logs are searchable and available to platform and dev teams. App logs (stdout/log files) are shipped to a central system. Complete Enterprise Architecture NFR before production.
1.3 | Auditability | Audit trail | Maintain logs of user and system activity to support failure analysis and incident response. Complete Enterprise Architecture NFR before production.
1.5 | Auditability | Tracking ID for log messages | Include a unique request/trace ID in log messages to follow request flow. NFR completed and validated before production.
1.6 | Auditability | Log API calls | Log REST API calls to capture external component interactions for troubleshooting. NFR completed and validated before production.
1.8 | Auditability | Log application messages | Use standard logging libraries to capture the right information in the right format. NFR completed and validated before production.
1.10 | Auditability | Avoid logging sensitive data | Do not log confidential/restricted data; mask/remove before persisting. NFR completed and validated before production.
2.7 | Auditability | UI error handling | Critical/error logs from client devices (mobile/browser) are sent to the central log system. NFR completed and validated before production.
1.1 | Error Handling | Log system errors | System errors are logged. Enterprise Architecture NFR completed before production.
1.3 | Error Handling | Use HTTP standard error codes | APIs and internal controllers return standard HTTP status codes/headers for consistent error handling. NFR completed before production.
2.4 | Error Handling | Client error tracking | Include client error tracking. NFR completed and validated before production.
1.5 | Availability | Timeouts | Set latency controls/timeouts on I/O operations to prevent excessive waits. NFR completed and validated before production.
1.12 | Availability | Retry logic | Use retry logic to handle transient failures. NFR completed and validated before production.
3.6 | Availability | Throttling / Drop requests | Throttle and drop requests when capacity limits are reached to protect ongoing traffic. Enterprise Architecture NFR completed before production.
3.9 | Availability | Circuit breakers on outgoing requests | Use circuit breakers to prevent repeated failures during maintenance/external outages. Enterprise Architecture NFR completed before production.
3.18 | Availability | Auto scale | System (whole or parts) can auto-scale based on telemetry to avoid outages/degradation. Enterprise Architecture NFR completed before production.
2 | Testing | Automated regression testing | Regression tests must cover all critical and functional areas of the app/component.
